_comment: Villagers, quests and named creatures. Edit this file to change names, dialogue, rewards and monster strength; no recompiling needed. The game reads assets/content.json next to the program if it exists, otherwise the copy built into it. The ids (Elder, Slay_Grishnak, Grishnak, ...) must match the enums in village.odin; item ids match Item_Kind in items.odin.

npcs.name: Elder Mara
npcs.idle_line: You have done more than enough. Rest a while.

npcs.name: Tomas the smith
npcs.idle_line: The forge is hot, but I've nothing for you now.

quests.title: Slay Grishnak (depth 2)
offer: Grishnak, a goblin warlord, raids us from
the second depth. Our fields burn.
Slay him, and you'll have gold, and
the chain shirt my son once wore.
thanks: Grishnak is dead? The village owes you.

quests.title: Bring Tomas a spiked club
offer: Ogres carry clubs studded with old iron.
Bring me one in your backpack, and I'll
reforge the nails into a proper blade.
quests.reminder: No club yet? The ogres below carry them.
thanks: Ha! Good iron under all that rust.

quests.title: Slay Gorluk (depth 4)
offer: With Grishnak gone, Gorluk the ogre
chieftain gathers the tribes at depth 4.
End him, and songs will be sung of you.
thanks: Gorluk is dead. The songs begin tonight.
This is all the gold we could gather.
